issues_found.description: vite.config.ts imported defineConfig from 'vitest/config'. Vitest 3 bundles its own version of vite which uses rollup-based plugin types. Vite 8 uses rolldown-based plugin types. The react() and tailwindcss() plugins returned types incompatible with the vitest-bundled vite's Plugin<any> type, causing TS2769 (overload mismatch) and tsc -b exit 2.
issues_found.fix_applied: Cast react() and tailwindcss() as `any` in the plugins array. The import of defineConfig from 'vitest/config' is retained to keep the test.* block typed. Runtime behaviour is completely unaffected.
